picks.catalyst: Added to S&P SmallCap 600 (effective before open Nov 19)
picks.why: SiteOne jumped about 7% after hours Monday because it is being added to the S&P SmallCap 600 index on Thursday, which forces index funds to buy the stock; price is estimated from Monday's $110.90 close plus the after-hours gain, so check the real pre-market quote and watch whether the gap holds.

picks.catalyst: Nvidia cut its Intel stake by 25% (filing) - sentiment hit, not a business problem
picks.why: Intel is down about 3% pre-market after a filing showed Nvidia sold a quarter of its Intel shares; that hurts mood but doesn't change Intel's business, so this kind of drop can bounce - but the stock already fell 7% Monday and faces a shareholder lawsuit, so wait for buyers to show up before going long.

Disney beat profit and sales estimates this morning, raised its dividend by a third and plans about $9 billion of buybacks, so the news is clearly good; the pre-market move is only about 2% (under the usual 3% bar), so it is a quality name to watch rather than a big gapper.
